subject.title: Add re-authenticate actions for Codex/Kiro, and a background-repair toggle for Claude

question: Should CodexBar officially expose an opt-in Claude mode that may re-prompt Keychain access in background repair, alongside a Settings action that launches kiro-cli login?
rationale: The code preserves the default mode, but deciding whether these authentication and privacy behaviors belong in the supported Settings surface requires product and security-UX judgment beyond mechanical correctness.

options.title: Approve the opt-in recovery surface
options.body: Accept the explicitly opt-in Keychain and Kiro CLI behavior after contributor proof demonstrates the real flows and failure handling.

options.title: Keep manual recovery only
options.body: Retain the existing user-initiated Refresh and terminal-based recovery paths if background Keychain prompting or Kiro CLI launching is outside the desired product boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in recovery surface
recommendation.body: Accept the explicitly opt-in Keychain and Kiro CLI behavior after contributor proof demonstrates the real flows and failure handling.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership is the best available signal for the provider-recovery and privacy-UX decision.
